title: Anyone tried GPT-6 Sol with Blender yet?
author: casperrb
selftext: Really curious to see if it's close to astra performance since its like 5 times as cheap as astra. Will be trying it myself soon but I'd like to hear what other people their results are.

comments.body: I wanna know if the usage drain is just as heavy as Astra

replies.author: casperrb
replies.body: Think the price of the new sol is 5 times as low as astra

replies.body: Sol and Luna 6 are dirt cheap compared to Astra.

comments.author: Izolight
comments.body:
Haven't run sol yet, but gpt-6 luna max already seems to give good results, seems comparable to astra low.

[http://render-arena.izolight.xyz/#compare?model=gpt-6-luna&model\_b=gpt-6-astra&prompt=underwater-shipwreck&effort\_a=max&effort\_b=low](http://render-arena.izolight.xyz/#compare?model=gpt-6-luna&model_b=gpt-6-astra&prompt=underwater-shipwreck&effort_a=max&effort_b=low)

replies.author: casperrb
replies.body: But if I look at this deepseek flash 4.1 does just fine too. When I look at these examples I don't see a reason to justify using astra or sol when they use so much more tokens. There isn't even that big of a difference

replies.author: Izolight
replies.body: well astra and sol actually use less tokens, but are of course more expensive. They seem to get it right quicker while the smaller models iterate much more on max mode to accomplish similar results. Check also the time taken, astra low takes under 5min, whereas luna max takes over 20min.

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: Astra is a visual model. Sol is planning, Luna is gruntwork. So no, it will not do well in blender because it's not visual like Astra. PS, Sol is as good as Astra in anything that isn't visual.

replies.author: TopTippityTop
replies.body: Are you sure Astra doesn't have a leg up on general intelligence? It sure seems like it, despite sol being quite solid.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body:
Think of sol 6 as a bit better than 5.6 at half the cost. Honestly, I'm pretty happy with that. It's a workhorse. I've run 4-5 chats continuously most of the day (over 8 hrs for sure), one of them being Astra high-max, the others Sol 6 high-xhigh, and have spent about 16-18%, which isn't bad at all. 

A few days ago I was burning all of it in a little over a day of usage with 1-2 ongoing chats. Jt's a huge improvement and I'm finally making good progress again.

However, if you want raw power, it seems like opus 5.5 is a beast. I would guesstimate based on benchmarks I've seen that it burns tokens a bit over 2x of Sol 6, but for 25% more intelligence. Worth it on some hard tasks where quality is paramount, but not most.

comments.author: KnownPride
comments.body: The only update on 6 sol is it's cost. Nothing else.
